thread:
Maya (CSM): heads-up — Sparrow's embedding pipeline spiked token burn ~3x overnight, hit our daily spend alert. looks concentrated on realtime search writes.
Owen (FinOps): saw the billing-bot. putting a soft throttle on their key for now. sending a quick spend breakdown. :eyes:
billing-bot: ALERT: account=sparrow, metric=daily_spend, value=4.1x expected, threshold=2.0x, ts=2026-03-22T21:12:03Z
Raj (AE): renewal is Jun 1. this spike is risky. need a short remediation plan to show in the QBR.
Linh (OnboardEng): checking onboarding logs — they flipped to dense embeddings and are sending many small requests (batch_size=1). also see repeated near-duplicate vectors causing recompute.
Casey (Product): if it's high QPS with tiny batches, batching + async ingestion will help. can we give a copy-paste client example?
Maya (CSM): recommend: (1) temporary rate cap, (2) client-side batching patch, (3) offer quantized embedding variant (INT8) as lower-cost fallback, (4) 30m enablement call tomorrow to align on freshness vs cost.
Owen (FinOps): temporary throttle = 50 rps on embeddings route for 24h. proposing $5k retainer credit to soften renewal talk — will escalate to finance.
Linh (OnboardEng): batching example to share:

```
# pseudo-client batching
queue = []
def enqueue(item):
  queue.append(item)
  if len(queue) >= 128 or time_since(last_flush) > 0.5:
    send_batch(queue)
    queue.clear()
```

Linh (OnboardEng): also toggling larger KV cache for their pool to avoid recompute on repeated lookups.
Raj (AE): retainer credit good to reduce churn risk. I'll own the ask.
Casey (Product): quick config tweak: limit embedding context to 512 tokens for background index jobs, combine with prefix caching. should cut per-request tokens.
Maya (CSM): action items: Linh post patch + rollout steps; Owen apply throttle + chase finance on credit; Raj draft QBR short (what happened, mitigation, long-term plan, credit request); Casey prepare quantized-variant notes with expected % savings.
Linh (OnboardEng): patch uploaded to Sparrow onboarding repo (internal link). will paste the exact client diff in the invite.

Raj (AE): I'll prepare a one-slide QBR summary: incident timeline, immediate mitigations, recommendations, credit ask.
Casey (Product): for the slide: conservative estimates — batching => ~35% cost reduction; quantized embeddings => ~40-50% inference cost delta.
Maya (CSM): customer note: Sparrow needs <5s search freshness. we'll test a canary (10% of writes) with batching to validate latency impact.
Linh (OnboardEng): canary plan: 10% rollout, monitor latency, tokens/request, cost/min, and failback knob.
Owen (FinOps): marking renewal_risk=medium until post-call; updating account-health dashboard.
